people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

people.name: Ruth
people.line: Moabite woman, ancestor of David and Jesus

translations.web: Ruth the Moabitess said, “Yes, he said to me, ‘You shall stay close to my young men until they have finished all my harvest.’ ”
translations.bsb: Then Ruth the Moabitess said, “He also told me, ‘Stay with my young men until they have finished gathering all my harvest.’”
translations.kjv: And Ruth the Moabitess said, He said unto me also, Thou shalt keep fast by my young men, until they have ended all my harvest.
translations.asv: And Ruth the Moabitess said, Yea, he said unto me, Thou shalt keep fast by my young men, until they have ended all my harvest.
